sources: https://www.moberlymo.org/DocumentCenter/View/2060 (Rules and Regulations for the Thompson Campground, Word document)

values.note: Full-hookup sites $35 a night, $200 a week, $700 a month; electric-only overflow $25 a night. Paid in advance; a refund for dates cancelled at least 24 hours ahead is less one night's fee.

fees.source: https://www.moberlymo.org/DocumentCenter/View/2060 ('Campground Fees: RV Camping: $35/Night, $200/week, $700/Month, $25/Night Electric Only Overflow'; 'ALL CAMPERS MUST PAY FOR THEIR STAY IN ADVANCE'; refund policy), read 2026-11-08

hookups.source: https://www.moberlymo.org/DocumentCenter/View/2060 ('Full hook-up at sites numbers 1 through 24 are provided with 50amp, 30amp, 110 volt, and water and sewer hook-up') + https://www.moberlymo.org/176/Campground, read 2026-11-08

sites.source: https://www.moberlymo.org/176/Campground ('Thompson Campground offers 24 full hook-up RV spaces. Each space has a concrete pad, electricity, water and sewer connections'), read 2026-11-08

facilities.source: https://www.moberlymo.org/176/Campground ('Thompson Campground offers a year-round shower, restroom facility'), read 2026-11-08

season.source: https://www.moberlymo.org/176/Campground ('a year-round shower, restroom facility') + https://www.moberlymo.org/DocumentCenter/View/2060 ('All campers are required to use a heated water supply connection . . . during cold weather months'; group camping alone is limited to April-October), read 2026-11-08

values.note: By phone: Moberly Parks & Recreation office 660-269-8705 x2040, or the Park Ranger 660-998-0143 during ranger hours. Campers sign the rule sheet with the ranger; check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm. Month-to-month stays allowed; local residents (within 30 miles) 14 days at most.

booking.source: https://www.moberlymo.org/176/Campground ('Assistance / Make A Reservation Call Moberly Parks & Recreation office 660-269-8705 x2040 or the Park Ranger 660-998-0143 during Park Ranger hours'; 'campers must sign off on a rule sheet with the Park Ranger') + https://www.moberlymo.org/DocumentCenter/View/2060 ('Check-out time is 2:00 p.m. Check-in time is 3:00 p.m.'; 'RV campers may stay for recreational camping on a month-to-month basis'; 'No local (permanent residence/address within 30 miles) campers for more than 14 days'), read 2026-11-08

note: City of Moberly campground in 465-acre Rothwell Park, next to the park's miniature railroad and maze garden, with the park's lakes, trails and aquatic center within walking distance. Campers must tow their own rig and have a permanent residence elsewhere. --Claude
summary: City pages: 24 concrete full-hookup sites (50/30A, water, sewer), $35/night ($200/week, $700/month; electric-only overflow $25); year-round showers/restrooms; reservations by phone only (Parks & Rec office or the Park Ranger). Waterfront not re-checked (no lead).
flags: Booking: phone only - Parks & Recreation 660-269-8705 x2040, or the Park Ranger 660-998-0143 during ranger hours; no online system. The stored phone 660-269-8705 is the city's main/Parks number (fine; x2040 for the campground).

Fees: base written as $35 (the 24 full-hookup sites). The rules also list '$25/Night Electric Only Overflow' - an overflow area, not one of the 24 sites, so not used as nightly_low; it is in fees.note.

Long-stay mix: month-to-month camping is allowed ($700/month; 'For monthly campers, nightly rate after six months'), but the city calls it 'a recreational campground, not a substitute for a residence', requires a permanent address elsewhere and caps locals at 14 days. Nightly stays are sold by phone at a posted rate. Public campground; keep.
Season: written year_round on the year-round shower/restroom and the cold-weather heated-hose rule; the city does not state 'open year-round' in those words.
